verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout remains readable with effort, but very small text and several long dashed detours prevent comfortable arm’s-length tracing.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have generous surrounding air, though the small type and a few labels positioned near vertical edge traffic reduce arm’s-length fluency.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Eight numbered containers plus two large titled lower regions make membership immediately clear without requiring edge tracing.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: The main gray flow is mostly clean, but multiple red dashed failure routes make long perimeter-scale detours, run in close parallel, and force substantial backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Ink density is low and air dominates, with most sections holding only two to four nodes; the main failure is excessive unused canvas rather than crowding.
